tasks.title: Implement static opening hours page
tasks.description: Develop a static web page that displays the fixed opening hours text.

tasks.title: Test opening hours display
tasks.description: Verify the page renders the correct text for unauthenticated users and contains no extra features.

tasks.title: Deploy to company environment
tasks.description: Publish the page to the existing company hosting environment and domain.

acceptance_criteria.given: an Office visitor accesses the page
acceptance_criteria.then: the browser displays the text 'Monday to Friday, 09:00-17:00'

acceptance_criteria.given: an Office visitor is not signed in
acceptance_criteria.when: the visitor navigates to the page
acceptance_criteria.then: the page contents are immediately readable

acceptance_criteria.given: an Office visitor accesses the page
acceptance_criteria.when: the visitor inspects the page components
acceptance_criteria.then: there are no editing controls, booking forms, or user account login widgets found

acceptance_criteria.given: the page deployment process is initiated
acceptance_criteria.then: the page is available via the existing company domain within the existing company infrastructure
